signature:
theorem radialLevels_hasLaw (n : ℕ+) (h : ℕ)
    (x : Fin (h + 1) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n.val)) :
    let L := Fin (h + 1)
    let P := {p : Fin (2 ^ (64 * (h + 1)) + 1) // Even p.val ∧ 4 ≤ p.val}
    let B := L × P
    let C := fun b : B ↦
      ((Fin b.2.val.val × (Σ j : Fin (h - b.1.val + 1),
        Fin ((2 ^ (74 * (h + 1))) ^ j.val))) → Fin n.val)
    let E := fun b : B ↦ EuclideanSpace ℝ (C b)
    let degree := fun p : P ↦
      (⟨p.val.val, p.property.1, p.property.2, Nat.le_of_lt_succ p.val.isLt⟩ :
        {p : ℕ // Even p ∧ 4 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ 2 ^ (64 * (h + 1))})
    let S := fun i : L ↦ ∑ j : Fin (h - i.val + 1), (2 ^ (74 * (h + 1))) ^ j.val
    let a := fun (i : L) (p : P) ↦ 1 / ((p.val.val : ℝ) ^ 4 * (S i : ℝ) ^ 2 *
      Real.sqrt ((h - i.val + 1 : ℕ) * Real.log (2 * (2 : ℝ) ^ (64 * (h + 1)) * S i)))
    let χ := fun r : ℝ ↦
      expNegInvGlue (r - 13 / 20) /
        (expNegInvGlue (r - 13 / 20) + expNegInvGlue (7 / 10 - r)) *
      (expNegInvGlue (1 - r) /
        (expNegInvGlue (1 - r) + expNegInvGlue (r - 19 / 20)))
    let tail := fun (i : L) (j : Fin (h - i.val + 1)) ↦ x ⟨i.val + j.val, by omega⟩
    let c := fun i : L ↦ ∏ j, χ (‖tail i j‖ / Real.sqrt n.val)
    let field := fun (i : L) (z : (p : P) → E (i, p)) ↦
      if ∃ j, tail i j = 0 then 0 else
        c i * ∑ p : P, angularDegreeComponent n h i (degree p)
          (fun j ↦ NormedSpace.normalize (tail i j)) (z p)
    let Ω := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Σ b : B, C b)
    let H := fun (ξ : Ω) (i : L) ↦ field i
      (fun p ↦ WithLp.toLp 2 (fun k : C (i, p) ↦ ξ ⟨(i, p), k⟩))
    HasLaw H (Measure.pi fun i : L ↦
      gaussianReal 0 (((n.val : ℝ) * (c i) ^ 2 * ∑ p : P, (a i p) ^ 2).toNNReal))
      (stdGaussian Ω)

TYPING: n:ℕ+; h:ℕ; x is one deterministic full tuple x_0,…,x_h. tail i j indexes the actual x_(i+j), with 0≤j≤h−i.
Allowed even degrees, ordered tensor slots, and exact amplitudes are unchanged. The common sample carrier is the full Euclidean space of the tagged coefficient coordinates.
STANDING: The isolated finite law holds for all positive n and natural h. The paper's large n, h(n), parameter restrictions and admissible event are not generalized.

definition_audit.body: No new global definitions. The let-bound field at level i uses only the product of the i-th level degree blocks and exactly the projected tail of the same x. Its values are the previous single-level expression with the identical literal unscaled cutoff, tensor normalization, coefficients, and zero extension. H extracts every actual (i,p) block by coordinate projection on the common joint carrier; no independent samples are postulated.
